trigger: mandatory post-approval agent-image construction and runtime validation

failures.observed: The approved Dockerfile installed Forge 1.7.1 in /usr/local/bin but invoked an unqualified forge command while the base-image PATH selected /home/agent/.foundry/bin/forge 1.3.6.
failures.impact: The pinned-version assertion failed and the approved image recipe was not buildable as written.

failures.observed: After selecting /usr/local/bin/forge explicitly, blanket PDF deletion removed tracked audit PDFs inside recursive OpenZeppelin dependencies and made the root report M lib/openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable.
failures.impact: The source tree in the built image did not satisfy the clean-worktree invariant.

failures.observed: Without a runtime PATH and FOUNDRY_SOLC override, an agent shell could still select the base image's older Foundry after a successful build layer.
failures.impact: Runtime compilation would not be bound to the toolchain used for validation.

dockerfile_changes: invoke the pinned Forge binary by absolute path during construction
remove nested submodule Git metadata after dependency verification and recreate eight inert empty repositories with exclude-all rules
remove root .git/modules and assert every nested repository has no HEAD, remotes, or object files
assert the root remains clean after report-file removal
put /usr/local/bin first at runtime and pin FOUNDRY_OFFLINE and FOUNDRY_SOLC

superseded_isolated_admission.reason: It contains the exact approved C1 bytes, not the corrected C1R1 bytes.

decision: The exact C1 approval cannot authorize changed candidate bytes. C1R1 must be validated and explicitly approved at its own review-manifest digest before admission or publication resumes.
